name: Fists of Steel
text: Unarmed attacks get +2 Strength and Damage 2.

name: Iron Man
text: Flesh Wounds never lower this fighter's Toughness, though it is still taken Out of Action once its Flesh Wounds reach its Toughness.

name: Immovable Stance
text: Double action (Tank). Until its next activation begins, the fighter adds 2 to its saves (best 2+), cannot be Pinned, and cannot be shifted by Hurl, Overseer, Knockback, Drag or anything similar.

name: Naaargah!
text: After its two actions the fighter can attempt a third by passing a Toughness test. Whether it passes or fails, it finishes the activation Pinned, and Nerves of Steel cannot stop that.

name: Unleash the Beast
text: Simple action (Flex), only while Engaged: each fighter in base contact, friend or enemy, must pass a Strength test or be pushed D3 inches directly away.

name: Walk It Off
text: If the fighter took two or more Move (Simple) actions this activation, a Toughness test at the end of it restores a lost Wound or removes a Flesh Wound.
